blocks.text: It was billed as a “Sabah Homecoming”. However, it ended in a military intrusion that reshaped Malaysia’s border defense system, and set off a chain reaction of legal fallout, including the US$14.9 billion Sulu arbitration. After traveling deep into the southern Philippines to investigate the Sulu Sultanate family behind the 2013 intrusion into Lahad Datu, Sabah, I sat down this week in Kuala Lumpur with a Malaysian security contact to uncover what really happened on our side of the border, and the hidden motives that drove those fateful events.
